// No function or constant carries a name from the table, but this is still a second list of
// permission names: the preview actor must take PERMISSIONS from packages/shared.
const everything = [
  'users:read',
  'groups:read',
  'groups:members:write',
  'distributionlists:read',
  'settings:branding',
];

export const previewPermissions = new Set(everything);
